appStore.name: Pluck: Read It Later
appStore.subtitle: Reading list, minus the guilt
appStore.promotionalText: Your tabs are breeding. Pluck the page, not just the link, sort it when you feel like it, and let what you never touch drift to the Archive. Nothing is deleted.
appStore.description:
You have 47 tabs open and a note called "read this". Pluck is where all of that goes, and then it gets out of your way.

Pluck it from any app. Tap Share, then Pluck. The page is kept the way you saw it, and the app doesn't even bother opening.

Sort it later. Or never. Everything lands in your Inbox. Swipe right for Later, left for the Archive. Tag it, put it on a List, or tick off a Todo.

The page, not just the link. Pluck keeps the text of every page, so you can read it in a clean reader, offline, long after the site has changed its mind.

A list is a plan. A trip, a talk, a kitchen, a reading list for a friend. Order it by hand, add a note to each item, tick off what's done, and share it only when you want to.

Find it in a second. Search covers titles, notes, tags and every word of every page. Even the ones you skimmed.

On iPad it spreads out. Your Inbox in one column, the page in the next, and a key for every move. Hold ⌘ to see them.

Bring your own AI. There's no AI inside Pluck. Connect the AI tools you already use, like Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor, and ask what you plucked this week, or have them tidy your Inbox while you watch. They can read, they can sort, and they can never delete.

Nothing is deleted. Leave something untouched for 30 days (or 14, or 90, or never) and it moves to the Archive on its own. Search still finds them, and Restore brings them back.

Free and open source. Use getpluck.io, or run your own server. No ads, no selling, and it doesn't follow you home.

chrome.summary: Pluck the page you are on into your Pluck library, with one click.
chrome.description:
Pluck the page you are on. One click keeps it in your Pluck library, with the text as you see it, so you can read it later, find it again, or ask your AI about it.

Click Pluck, or press Alt+Shift+P. "Plucked" appears with the title, and the popup lets you add a tag, change the Kind, put it on a List, write a note, or send it straight to Later or the Archive.

Right-click a link, an image or the page to pluck it without opening it. Select a sentence and press Alt+Shift+H to keep it as a highlight. Pluck all your tabs into a new List at once.

Pages behind your logins are kept as your browser rendered them. YouTube videos come with their transcript, so search and your AI tools can read what was said.

The Pluck icon fills in on pages already in your library, so you can see at a glance what you have plucked.

No connection? Plucks wait on your computer and go when you are back online.

Pluck is open source. Use getpluck.io, or build the extension for a server you run yourself. There is no AI inside Pluck: you connect the AI tools you already use, if you want to.

Needs a free Pluck account at https://getpluck.io.
